# Camp Resource: Beehive

__Beehive__

How sweet it is to harvest your own Honey!

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

Honey

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Beehive (Black & Yellow)

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

1 Pound

Season 4 - Armor Ace and the Power Patrol in Cold Steel - Rank 5 - Free

Gold Bullion - Samuel - Cautious - 750 Bullion

Atom Shop - __Bee Keeper Bundle__ - 1000 Atoms

7 minutes and 12 seconds

Yes

No

1 Flamingo Unit
